title: The Hermit Monk
text: A monk who has not spoken in forty years sits by the road to the shrines, thin as a stick, his beard to his knees. His eyes are kind. He holds up a slate with chalk letters on it, written long ago and never wiped: ASK ME ONE THING.

outcomes.text: He wipes the slate for the first time in forty years, and draws a map.

options.label: The wisest asks about the House's future.

outcomes.text: He writes one word, and weeps, and will not wipe it away.
He touches each brow with a chalky thumb, and the dust stays all day.
